note: IICRC CEC approvals registry — the single source of truth for CEC hours (licence-critical). A course may display CEC hours ONLY when it has an entry here with status 'approved' and founder-recorded approvedHours. Entries are added by the founder after per-course IICRC approval via CECCourse@iicrcnet.org (submission pack: scripts/generate-cec-submission.ts). Validated in CI by npm run check:cec. Current contents: 38 classes recorded 2026-08-27 from the IICRC CEC Accredited class list for CARSI supplied by the founder (CARSI_courses.pdf, 2 pages; approval batches 2024-01-18, 2024-05-06, 2024-06-20 and 2025-05-15, each expiring three years after approval).
